scope: HookAppCatalog.targets generic controls only; excludes dedicated editors and module-only AppearanceOptions
ownershipRule: Each key occurs exactly once across all recursive features[].optionKeys. optionKeys includes this node toggleKey plus its direct parameters only. parameterKeys excludes toggleKey. allOptionKeys recursively aggregates this node and descendants, for indexing only.
renderingRules: With toggleKey and hasConfiguration:false: one name/help/switch row, no disclosure arrow.

With toggleKey and hasConfiguration:true: one feature card with name/help/switch/disclosure arrow; hide parameters and child features while the real toggle is off; preserve all parameter values when switched off.
Recursive features are dependent boolean controls. Keep them inside the outer card. Each child with parameters has its own disclosure; hide that child input while its toggle is off.
toggleKey:null marks a parameter with no real Android enable switch. activation describes its true no-op/default test; never invent a module setting or attach it to an unrelated boolean.
effectiveWhen describes native applicability in addition to the outer toggle. It is not ownership and does not request resetting or dropping any value.
